Name: Operations director
What: Owns end-to-end fulfillment performance, carrier relationships, and SLA commitments.

Name: Order manager
What: Processes incoming orders, validates payments, and sets warehouse priority.

Name: Warehouse lead
What: Directs pick-and-pack, owns inventory accuracy, and oversees outbound shipments.

Name: Customer support lead
What: Handles delivery inquiries, manages returns, and resolves post-shipment exceptions.

Name: Merchandising manager
What: Owns the catalog — what is listed, how it is priced, and when it goes live.

Name: Order fulfillment
What: Placement through delivery confirmation, across catalog, inventory, and fulfillment.

Name: Receive order
What: Ingest the order, validate line items, and confirm the SKUs are sellable.

Name: Verify payment
What: Confirm authorization; hold or decline anything the processor flags.

Name: Reserve inventory
What: Hold stock at the fulfilling location and trigger replenishment if it goes short.

Name: Pick & pack
What: Retrieve the items, verify quantities, and package for the carrier.

Name: Dispatch shipment
What: Generate the label, hand off to the carrier, and publish tracking to the order.

Name: Confirm delivery
What: Verify carrier confirmation, close the order, and open the post-purchase follow-up.

Name: Payment clears before stock moves
What: No stock is reserved until payment authorization has cleared.

Name: Only warehouse dispatches
What: Dispatch is the warehouse’s call. Support can ask; it cannot ship.

Name: Returns are supports to approve
What: Only support authorizes returns, so refund exposure has one owner.

Name: Catalog goes live through merchandising
What: Nothing reaches the storefront without merchandising publishing it.

Name: Storefront
What: Customer-facing catalog and checkout.

Name: Order service
What: Order lifecycle and payment verification.

Name: Inventory service
What: Stock positions and reservations.

Name: Fulfillment worker
What: Runs the pick, pack, and dispatch steps against carrier APIs.

Name: Commerce db
What: Orders, catalog, inventory, shipments.
